simple.en: Sahaj grows through Guru’s grace and inward Shabad-attention, not merely multiplying external ritual actions.
simple.pa: ਸਹਜ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜਨ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ; ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਬਾਹਰਲੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਾਫ਼ੀ ਨਹੀਂ।

study.focus: The question “how can the mind be cleansed?”
study.closeReading: The pauri repeatedly pairs ritual action with lingering doubt, then asks how the inward stain can be washed. The practical turn is the fourth line—attach the mind to the Shabad and Hari. The final line attributes enduring Sahaj to Guru’s grace instead of technique alone.
study.interpretationCare: Sahaj is not simply a measurable calm state, and “doubt” is not a diagnosis. Do not promise a religious practice as a treatment for anxiety disorders or other health conditions.
study.reflection: When have repeated routines failed to address what was troubling me inwardly?
study.teachBack: Which line moves from criticism of ritual to an inward practice?

simple.en: A spotless outward appearance cannot substitute for inner truth when craving and falsehood rule the mind.
simple.pa: ਬਾਹਰਲੀ ਸੁਚਾਈ ਅੰਦਰਲੀ ਸੱਚਾਈ ਦਾ ਬਦਲ ਨਹੀਂ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨਾ ਅਤੇ ਕੂੜ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੀ ਸੇਧ ਖੋਹ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ।

study.focus: Contrasting visible purity with inward responsibility.
study.closeReading: The first two lines set the direct inner–outer contrast and the striking image of life lost in gambling. The third names unsatisfied craving and mortality; the fourth points to Naam yet describes people ignoring it. The concluding line binds them to the truth-versus-falsehood decision. This imagery is a warning about values, not a label for people.

words.workingGloss: Falsehood or what lacks Truth, context dependent

study.interpretationCare: The word “rog” for craving is metaphorical. Never equate this spiritual critique with diagnosis, shame people with substance-use or other medical conditions, or present it as clinical care.
study.reflection: How can I compare what I appear to value with what I actually do?
study.teachBack: How does the image of gambling away life connect to abandoning Truth?

simple.en: The companion to Pauri 19 emphasizes outward and inward truth together, cultivated through the Guru’s teaching.
simple.pa: ਉੱਨੀਵੀਂ ਪਉੜੀ ਦੇ ਉਲਟ, ਇੱਥੇ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਰਮ ਦੋਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਚਾਈ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜਦੀ ਹੈ।

study.focus: The paired answer to Pauri 19.
study.closeReading: The immediately previous pauri began “dirty inside, clean outside.” This one deliberately reverses that to “clean inside, clean outside,” then explains the Guru-oriented conduct behind it. The trade/gem imagery means the human opportunity has been used wisely, not that spiritual life is a financial enterprise.

words.workingGloss: Traders, used as a metaphor for people making good use of life

study.interpretationCare: Do not make “purity” into caste hierarchy or claim that a person with illness, disability or grief is spiritually unclean. The trading image has no promise of monetary profit.
study.reflection: What concrete action could bring my outer behaviour closer to my inner commitments?
study.teachBack: How does Pauri 20 answer the inner–outer contrast begun in Pauri 19?

jaap|jaap001.line01.simpleEn: The Divine is not contained by emblems, social colour, caste or inherited rank.
jaap|jaap001.line01.simplePa: ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਨੂੰ ਚਿੰਨ੍ਹ, ਰੰਗ, ਜਾਤ ਜਾਂ ਪਾਤ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਵਿਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਬੰਨ੍ਹ ਸਕਦੇ।
jaap|jaap001.line01.interpretiveCaution: The opening names human categories to question their application to the One.

jaap|jaap001.line02.simpleEn: No outward shape, appearance, distinguishing mark or clothing can fully depict the One.
jaap|jaap001.line02.simplePa: ਕੋਈ ਰੂਪ, ਰੰਗ, ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨ ਜਾਂ ਭੇਖ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
jaap|jaap001.line02.interpretiveCaution: Keep this poetic refusal of limiting form distinct from claims about how a human should dress.

jaap|jaap002.line01.simpleEn: A salutation to the Timeless One.
jaap|jaap002.line01.interpretiveCaution: A short salutation, not a definition that exhausts the Divine.

jaap|jaap002.line02.simpleEn: A salutation to the Compassionate One.
jaap|jaap002.line02.interpretiveCaution: Compassion sits beside timelessness in this chhand.

jaap|jaap002.line03.simpleEn: A salutation to the One beyond limiting form.
jaap|jaap002.line03.simplePa: ਰੂਪ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ।
jaap|jaap002.line03.interpretiveCaution: A devotional name, not an argument that images are the same as the One.

jaap|jaap002.line04.simpleEn: A salutation to the Incomparable One.
jaap|jaap002.line04.simplePa: ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਨਹੀਂ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ।
jaap|jaap002.line04.interpretiveCaution: The phrase completes the fourfold salutation.

savaiye|savaiye09.line04.simpleEn: The stanza culminates in a striking affirmation that love is the way to encounter the Divine.
savaiye|savaiye09.line04.simplePa: ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਤੁਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਦਾ ਮੁੱਖ ਰਾਹ ਦੱਸਦੀ ਹੈ।
savaiye|savaiye09.line04.interpretiveCaution: Interpretation of ਪ੍ਰੇਮ here needs contextual Sikh/Dasam scholarly review.

savaiye|savaiye04.line01.simpleEn: The line lists pilgrimage, giving, restraint and other religious disciplines.
savaiye|savaiye04.line01.simplePa: ਇਸ ਤੁਕ ਵਿਚ ਤੀਰਥ, ਦਾਨ, ਸੰਜਮ ਅਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਧਾਰਮਿਕ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਦਾ ਜ਼ਿਕਰ ਹੈ।
savaiye|savaiye04.line01.interpretiveCaution: This line lists practices; the entire stanza develops the contrast with inner devotion.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras01.line01.simpleEn: An opening request for Divine protection.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras01.line01.simplePa: ਪਹਿਲੀ ਤੁਕ ਵਿਚ ਰੱਬੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras01.line01.interpretiveCaution: Do not present this plea as a safety guarantee.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras01.line02.simpleEn: A prayer that heartfelt hopes may be fulfilled.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras01.line02.simplePa: ਮਨ ਦੀਆਂ ਆਸਾਂ ਪੂਰੀਆਂ ਹੋਣ ਦੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras01.line02.interpretiveCaution: This is prayer language, not a prediction of material results.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras01.line03.simpleEn: May my mind remain turned toward Your feet, an image of devoted refuge.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras01.line03.simplePa: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਵਿਚ ਲੱਗਾ ਰਹੇ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras01.line03.interpretiveCaution: Feet/charan functions as devotional imagery, not merely physical geography.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras01.line04.simpleEn: Care for me as one who belongs to You.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras01.line04.interpretiveCaution: The relationship matters as much as the protection requested.

anand|anand01.line01.simpleEn: Bliss has arisen, O mother, because I have found the True Guru.
anand|anand01.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਮਾਏ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਣ ਨਾਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਅਨੰਦ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ।
anand|anand01.line01.interpretiveCaution: A poetic first-person declaration, not a diagnosis of constant emotional happiness.

anand|anand02.line01.simpleEn: O my mind, remain in remembrance of the Divine.
anand|anand02.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ, ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜਿਆ ਰਹੁ।
anand|anand02.line01.interpretiveCaution: The speaker is addressing the mind; do not convert this into a medical claim.

anand|anand07.line01.simpleEn: Many speak of bliss, but the Guru’s wisdom shows what it truly is.
anand|anand07.line01.simplePa: ਅਨੰਦ ਦਾ ਨਾਂ ਸਭ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ; ਉਸ ਦੀ ਡੂੰਘੀ ਸਮਝ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੋਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ।
anand|anand07.line01.interpretiveCaution: The distinction between saying a word and experiencing its meaning matters.

sohila|sohila01.line03.simpleEn: Where the Creator is praised and reflected upon, spiritual understanding is cultivated.
sohila|sohila01.line03.simplePa: ਜਿੱਥੇ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਦੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਚਾਰ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉੱਥੇ ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਸਿੱਖਣ ਦਾ ਮੌਕਾ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila01.line03.interpretiveCaution: Read with the following invitation to sing praise, not as an address to one physical house only.

sohila|sohila03.line02.simpleEn: The sky is imagined as a platter, the sun and moon as lamps, and stars as jewels.
sohila|sohila03.line02.simplePa: ਆਕਾਸ਼ ਥਾਲ, ਸੂਰਜ ਤੇ ਚੰਦ ਦੀਵੇ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਮੋਤੀਆਂ ਵਾਂਗ ਹਨ।
sohila|sohila03.line02.interpretiveCaution: Cosmic aarti poetry, not an astronomical mechanism.

sohila|sohila05.line02.simpleEn: Listen, friends: this is the time to serve with humility.
sohila|sohila05.line02.simplePa: ਸੁਣੋ ਮਿੱਤਰੋ, ਇਹ ਸੇਵਾ ਦਾ ਵੇਲਾ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila05.line02.interpretiveCaution: Its urgency arises from the whole shabad’s reflection on time.

rehras|rehras.chaupai-rehras01.line01.simpleEn: The Rehras source now turns to a request for protection from Benti Chaupai.
rehras|rehras.chaupai-rehras01.line01.simplePa: ਰਹਿਰਾਸਿ ਵਿਚ ਇੱਥੇ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਚੌਪਈ ਦੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਵਾਲੀ ਅਰਦਾਸ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.chaupai-rehras01.line01.interpretiveCaution: The source family changes to Dasam Bani at this point.

rehras|rehras.anand01.line01.simpleEn: The selected Anand portion begins with joy arising through finding the True Guru.
rehras|rehras.anand01.line01.simplePa: ਰਹਿਰਾਸਿ ਦੇ ਚੁਣੇ ਅਨੰਦ ਭਾਗ ਦੀ ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਣ ਦੀ ਖੁਸ਼ੀ ਨਾਲ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ।
rehras|rehras.anand01.line01.interpretiveCaution: Anand’s forty-pauri original composition remains separate.

sohila|sohila01.line01.simpleEn: Source heading: this is Sohila, in Raag Gauree Deepakee, attributed to Guru Nanak Sahib (Mahala 1).
sohila|sohila01.line01.simplePa: ਇਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਦਾ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਹੈ: ਸੋਹਿਲਾ, ਰਾਗ ਗਉੜੀ ਦੀਪਕੀ, ਮਹਲਾ ਪਹਿਲਾ — ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ।
sohila|sohila01.line01.interpretiveCaution: A musical/source heading identifies the composition. It is not a new verse or a prescribed recording.

sohila|sohila01.line02.simpleEn: The opening invocation remembers the One, approached through the grace of the True Guru.
sohila|sohila01.line02.simplePa: ਆਰੰਭ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕ ਅਕਾਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਦੀ ਯਾਦ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila01.line02.interpretiveCaution: This is the written invocation, distinct from the shabad’s subsequent numbered lines.

sohila|sohila01.line04.simpleEn: In that place, sing the song of praise and keep the Creator in remembrance.
sohila|sohila01.line04.simplePa: ਉਸ ਥਾਂ ਸਿਫ਼ਤ ਦਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਗਾਵੋ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ਨੂੰ ਯਾਦ ਰੱਖੋ।
sohila|sohila01.line04.interpretiveCaution: The phrase “that home” refers back to the gathering/place of praise and reflection in the previous line.

sohila|sohila01.line05.simpleEn: Sing the joyful song of praise to the Fearless One.
sohila|sohila01.line05.simplePa: ਮੇਰੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਗਾਓ।
sohila|sohila01.line05.interpretiveCaution: The Fearless One is the Divine being praised, not a claim that the worshipper never feels fear.

sohila|sohila01.line06.simpleEn: I cherish this song of praise, through which lasting spiritual peace is sought. This is the refrain.
sohila|sohila01.line06.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਉਸ ਸੋਹਿਲੇ ਤੋਂ ਸਦਕੇ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹਾਂ ਜਿਸ ਨਾਲ ਟਿਕਾਊ ਆਤਮਕ ਸੁਖ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ; ਇਹ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੀ ਤੁਕ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila01.line06.interpretiveCaution: “Rahau” is the poem’s interpretive refrain, not a mechanical instruction about audio length.

sohila|sohila01.line07.simpleEn: Living beings are continually cared for; the Giver watches over and sustains them.
sohila|sohila01.line07.simplePa: ਜੀਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਨਿੱਤ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ; ਦਾਤਾਰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਦੇਖਭਾਲ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila01.line07.interpretiveCaution: The care of living beings is a devotional statement, not a guarantee against hardship or illness.

sohila|sohila01.line08.simpleEn: Your gifts cannot be fully measured; how could we set a limit on You, the Giver?
sohila|sohila01.line08.simplePa: ਤੇਰੀਆਂ ਦਾਤਾਂ ਦਾ ਮੁੱਲ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ; ਉਸ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਕੌਣ ਜਾਣ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ?
sohila|sohila01.line08.interpretiveCaution: The rhetorical question emphasizes the limits of human reckoning of generosity.

sohila|sohila01.line09.simpleEn: A date has been appointed; in wedding imagery, friends gather to prepare and anoint the bride with oil.
sohila|sohila01.line09.simplePa: ਵਿਆਹ ਦੇ ਰੂਪਕ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਾਹਾ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ; ਸਹੇਲੀਆਂ ਰਲ ਕੇ ਤੇਲ ਦੀ ਰਸਮ ਦੀ ਤਿਆਰੀ ਕਰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ।
sohila|sohila01.line09.interpretiveCaution: Wedding preparations are a metaphor for a soul facing a destined departure, not a literal ceremony required of readers.

sohila|sohila01.line10.simpleEn: Friends, give your blessings so that union with the Beloved Lord may come about.
sohila|sohila01.line10.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸੱਜਣੋ, ਅਸੀਸਾਂ ਦਿਓ ਕਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਪਣੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਹੋਵੇ।
sohila|sohila01.line10.interpretiveCaution: The blessings continue the wedding/union metaphor; they are not a predicted event date.

sohila|sohila01.line11.simpleEn: The invitation reaches every home; calls to depart keep arriving.
sohila|sohila01.line11.simplePa: ਹਰ ਘਰ ਸੱਦੇ ਪਹੁੰਚਦੇ ਹਨ; ਵਿਦਾਈ ਦਾ ਬੁਲਾਵਾ ਨਿੱਤ ਆ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila01.line11.interpretiveCaution: The imagery speaks to mortality across all households, not a request to fear a particular day.

sohila|sohila01.line12.simpleEn: Remember the One who calls, says Nanak; our own days of departure will also come.
sohila|sohila01.line12.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਸੱਦਾ ਭੇਜਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਮਰੋ, ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਸਾਡੇ ਲਈ ਵੀ ਉਹ ਦਿਨ ਆਉਣੇ ਹਨ।
sohila|sohila01.line12.interpretiveCaution: Mortality imagery invites meaningful remembrance; it is not a prediction of anyone’s lifespan.

sohila|sohila02.line01.simpleEn: Source heading: Raag Aasaa, Mahala 1, attributed to Guru Nanak Sahib.
sohila|sohila02.line01.simplePa: ਇਹ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਰਾਗ ਆਸਾ ਅਤੇ ਮਹਲਾ ਪਹਿਲਾ — ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ — ਦਰਸਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila02.line01.interpretiveCaution: Raag information is source metadata; it does not certify a particular modern melody.

sohila|sohila02.line02.simpleEn: The verse names six schools, six teachers and six forms of instruction.
sohila|sohila02.line02.simplePa: ਤੁਕ ਛੇ ਮੱਤਾਂ ਜਾਂ ਸ਼ਾਸਤਰਾਂ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਛੇ ਗੁਰੂਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਛੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਦਾ ਜ਼ਿਕਰ ਕਰਦੀ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila02.line02.interpretiveCaution: The traditional “six” refers to philosophical systems, not necessarily six separate physical houses.

sohila|sohila02.line03.simpleEn: Their forms and teachings may be many, yet the ultimate Divine Source is One.
sohila|sohila02.line03.simplePa: ਉਪਦੇਸ਼ ਅਤੇ ਰੂਪ ਕਈ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਪਿੱਛੇ ਮੂਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਇੱਕੋ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila02.line03.interpretiveCaution: This poetic claim of oneness does not mean that all historical philosophies agree on every doctrine.

sohila|sohila02.line04.simpleEn: O friend, hold close the place in which the Creator’s praise is spoken.
sohila|sohila02.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਭਾਈ, ਜਿਸ ਥਾਂ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਦੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਥਾਂ ਵੱਲ ਧਿਆਨ ਦੇ।
sohila|sohila02.line04.interpretiveCaution: The “house” can describe the gathering or environment of praise and reflection.

sohila|sohila02.line05.simpleEn: Protect that place of praise; it is for your good. This is the central refrain.
sohila|sohila02.line05.simplePa: ਉਸ ਸਿਫ਼ਤ ਵਾਲੇ ਆਸਰੇ ਨੂੰ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਕੇ ਰੱਖ, ਇਸੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਲਾਈ ਹੈ; ਇਹ ਰਹਾਉ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila02.line05.interpretiveCaution: The refrain gives practical focus to praise, not preference for any particular building.

sohila|sohila02.line06.simpleEn: Moments, hours, watches, lunar days, weekdays and months make up the changing measures of time.
sohila|sohila02.line06.simplePa: ਵਿਸੁਏ, ਚਸੇ, ਘੜੀਆਂ, ਪਹਰ, ਥਿੱਤਾਂ, ਵਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਮਹੀਨੇ — ਸਮੇਂ ਦੇ ਕਈ ਮਾਪ ਹਨ।
sohila|sohila02.line06.interpretiveCaution: Ancient time units are named as a poetic list; their precise conversion is not the focus of this teaching note.

sohila|sohila02.line07.simpleEn: There is one sun, though it is experienced across many seasons.
sohila|sohila02.line07.simplePa: ਸੂਰਜ ਇੱਕੋ ਹੈ ਪਰ ਰੁੱਤਾਂ ਅਨੇਕ ਹਨ।
sohila|sohila02.line07.interpretiveCaution: The single sun and many seasons illustrate unity amid changing appearances.

sohila|sohila02.line08.simpleEn: Nanak says the Creator appears to us in countless forms and expressions.
sohila|sohila02.line08.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ ਕਿ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਦੇ ਰੂਪ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਹਨ।
sohila|sohila02.line08.interpretiveCaution: This closes the sun/seasons comparison without limiting the Divine to visible physical shapes.

sohila|sohila03.line01.simpleEn: Source heading: Raag Dhanaasree, Mahala 1, attributed to Guru Nanak Sahib.
sohila|sohila03.line01.simplePa: ਇਹ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਰਾਗ ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਮਹਲਾ ਪਹਿਲਾ — ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ — ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila03.line01.interpretiveCaution: A written raag heading is separate from a claim about an audio recording’s performance.

sohila|sohila03.line03.simpleEn: Fragrant air becomes incense, the wind waves the ceremonial fan, and the flowering forest joins the light-filled offering.
sohila|sohila03.line03.simplePa: ਸੁਗੰਧੀ ਹਵਾ ਧੂਪ ਵਾਂਗ, ਪਵਣ ਚੌਰ ਵਾਂਗ ਅਤੇ ਫੁੱਲਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਭਰੇ ਬਨ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ਦੀ ਆਰਤੀ ਦਾ ਰੂਪ ਬਣਦੇ ਹਨ।
sohila|sohila03.line03.interpretiveCaution: Nature supplies poetic ritual imagery; the text is not prescribing a ritual instrument list.

sohila|sohila03.line04.simpleEn: What an extraordinary act of praise this is!
sohila|sohila03.line04.simplePa: ਕਿੰਨੀ ਅਦਭੁਤ ਆਰਤੀ ਦੀ ਇਹ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਹੈ!
sohila|sohila03.line04.interpretiveCaution: The exclamation follows cosmic imagery; it is not an ordinary question about how to perform a ritual.

sohila|sohila03.line05.simpleEn: O One who frees beings from the bondage of coming and going, this vast praise is Your aarti.
sohila|sohila03.line05.simplePa: ਹੇ ਜਨਮ-ਮਰਨ ਦੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੱਟਣ ਵਾਲੇ, ਇਹ ਵਿਸ਼ਾਲ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila03.line05.interpretiveCaution: Bhav-khandan is devotional language about spiritual bondage, not a clinical claim.

sohila|sohila03.line06.simpleEn: The unstruck sound is imagined as a great drum of praise; the refrain calls attention to the divine offering.
sohila|sohila03.line06.simplePa: ਅਨਹਦ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਵੱਡੀ ਭੇਰੀ ਦੇ ਨਾਦ ਵਾਂਗ ਵੱਜਦਾ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਹੈ; ਰਹਾਉ ਆਰਤੀ ਦੇ ਭਾਵ ਉੱਤੇ ਧਿਆਨ ਦਿਵਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila03.line06.interpretiveCaution: Anhad imagery should not be turned into a scientifically specified acoustic frequency.

sohila|sohila03.line07.simpleEn: You are praised as having countless eyes, yet no one limited eye; countless forms, yet no single confining form.
sohila|sohila03.line07.simplePa: ਤੇਰੀਆਂ ਅਣਗਿਣਤ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਤੇ ਰੂਪ ਕਹੇ ਗਏ ਹਨ, ਫਿਰ ਵੀ ਤੂੰ ਕਿਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਅੱਖ ਜਾਂ ਰੂਪ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ।
sohila|sohila03.line07.interpretiveCaution: The apparent contradiction is deliberate: Divine presence throughout creation without a limiting body.

sohila|sohila03.line08.simpleEn: Countless pure feet and perceptions are Yours, yet You are not restricted to one physical foot or sense of smell; this wonder captivates the speaker.
sohila|sohila03.line08.simplePa: ਅਨੇਕ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਚਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਦੇ ਅਨੁਭਵ ਤੇਰੇ ਦੱਸੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰ ਤੂੰ ਇੱਕ ਸਰੀਰਕ ਚਰਨ ਜਾਂ ਇੰਦਰੀ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ; ਇਹ ਅਚਰਜ ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਮੋਹ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila03.line08.interpretiveCaution: The verse pairs presence in all beings with the inability to assign one limiting physical body.

sohila|sohila03.line09.simpleEn: The One Divine Light is present within everyone.
sohila|sohila03.line09.simplePa: ਸਭ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਉਸ ਇੱਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੌਜੂਦ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila03.line09.interpretiveCaution: This is the poem’s spiritual vision of shared Divine light, not a claim about measurable photons.

sohila|sohila03.line10.simpleEn: Through that Light, light shines within all beings.
sohila|sohila03.line10.simplePa: ਉਸ ਦੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਦੇ ਚਾਨਣ ਨਾਲ ਸਭ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਚਾਨਣ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila03.line10.interpretiveCaution: The line develops the previous claim that the same Divine presence is in all.

sohila|sohila03.line11.simpleEn: Through the Guru’s teaching and witness, that Light becomes known or revealed.
sohila|sohila03.line11.simplePa: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਸਾਖੀ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਉਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਝ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਰਗਟ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila03.line11.interpretiveCaution: Guru-sakhi refers to the Guru’s teaching/testimony; it is not a licence to guess a historical anecdote.

sohila|sohila03.line12.simpleEn: What pleases the Divine is the true aarti, the worthy act of praise.
sohila|sohila03.line12.simplePa: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਭਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹੀ ਸੱਚੀ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila03.line12.interpretiveCaution: The line turns the cosmic metaphor toward sincerity, rather than outward spectacle alone.

sohila|sohila03.line13.simpleEn: My mind longs constantly for the nectar of the lotus-like Divine feet.
sohila|sohila03.line13.simplePa: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਕਮਲ-ਚਰਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਰਸ ਲਈ ਦਿਨ-ਰਾਤ ਤਰਸਦਾ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila03.line13.interpretiveCaution: Lotus-feet and nectar are devotional metaphors for longing and refuge, not literal anatomy or fluid.

sohila|sohila03.line14.simpleEn: Grant the water of compassion to this thirsty bird-like soul, says Nanak, so that it may abide in Your Naam.
sohila|sohila03.line14.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ: ਤ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨਾਤੁਰ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਵਾਂਗ ਇਸ ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦਾ ਜਲ ਦੇਹੋ ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਟਿਕੇ।
sohila|sohila03.line14.interpretiveCaution: The Sarang/thirsty bird is a traditional image; the request is for grace and remembrance.

sohila|sohila04.line01.simpleEn: Source heading: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Mahala 4, attributed to Guru Ram Das Sahib.
sohila|sohila04.line01.simplePa: ਇਹ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਰਾਗ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਅਤੇ ਮਹਲਾ ਚੌਥਾ — ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਮ ਦਾਸ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ — ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila04.line01.interpretiveCaution: This is authorship/raag information, not a separate meaning-bearing stanza.

sohila|sohila04.line02.simpleEn: The city of the mind is crowded by desire and anger; through the company of the Guru-oriented holy person, those forces are broken down.
sohila|sohila04.line02.simplePa: ਮਨ ਦੇ ਨਗਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਾਮ ਤੇ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਹੁਤ ਭਰੇ ਹਨ; ਸਾਧੂ ਜਾਂ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਸੰਗਤ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਇਹ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਟੁੱਟਣ ਲੱਗਦੇ ਹਨ।
sohila|sohila04.line02.interpretiveCaution: The “city” is an inner-life metaphor. Emotions are not themselves a medical diagnosis.

sohila|sohila04.line03.simpleEn: Through a grace-filled destiny the Guru is encountered, and the mind is adorned with loving attention to Hari.
sohila|sohila04.line03.simplePa: ਪੂਰਬਲੇ ਲੇਖ ਜਾਂ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਲ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਦੀ ਲਿਵ ਨਾਲ ਸਜਦਾ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila04.line03.interpretiveCaution: “Written before” belongs to the poem’s theological vocabulary; do not turn it into a prediction about a person’s fate.

sohila|sohila04.line04.simpleEn: Offer respectful folded hands to the saintly or Guru-oriented person; the verse values such humility greatly.
sohila|sohila04.line04.simplePa: ਸਾਧੂ ਅੱਗੇ ਆਦਰ ਨਾਲ ਅੰਜਲੀ ਜੋੜਨਾ ਵੱਡਾ ਪੁੰਨ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila04.line04.interpretiveCaution: The gesture stands for respect and humility; the lesson must not demand submission to an unaccountable individual.

sohila|sohila04.line05.simpleEn: Bow with humility; the refrain again honours respectful reverence.
sohila|sohila04.line05.simplePa: ਨਿਮਰਤਾ ਨਾਲ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਕਰੋ; ਰਹਾਉ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਦਰ ਦੇ ਭਾਵ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila04.line05.interpretiveCaution: This poetic praise of a gesture does not require a single outward ritual of all readers.

sohila|sohila04.line06.simpleEn: Those turned away from Hari do not know the taste of Divine love; ego remains like a thorn within.
sohila|sohila04.line06.simplePa: ਹਰਿ ਤੋਂ ਮੂੰਹ ਮੋੜਿਆ ਮਨ ਨਾਮ ਦੇ ਰਸ ਨੂੰ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਅਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰ ਕੰਡੇ ਵਾਂਗ ਚੁੱਭਦੀ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila04.line06.interpretiveCaution: The thorn is a moral/spiritual metaphor, not a physical injury or a label for condemning neighbours.

sohila|sohila04.line07.simpleEn: As they move through life, that inner thorn brings pain; the line uses the image of death’s discipline.
sohila|sohila04.line07.simplePa: ਜਿਵੇਂ ਜੀਵਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੁਰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਹਉਮੈ ਦਾ ਕੰਡਾ ਦੁੱਖ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ; ਜਮਕਾਲ ਦੇ ਡੰਡੇ ਦੀ ਤਿੱਖੀ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila04.line07.interpretiveCaution: Jamakal is traditional spiritual imagery; do not present it as proof of literal punishment for a reader.

sohila|sohila04.line08.simpleEn: Those who live immersed in Hari’s Naam find release from the suffering bound up with the world and repeated birth and death.
sohila|sohila04.line08.simplePa: ਹਰਿ ਦੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਜਨਮ-ਮਰਨ ਤੇ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਦੇ ਦੁੱਖ ਦੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋਂ ਛੁਟਕਾਰਾ ਲੱਭਦੇ ਹਨ।
sohila|sohila04.line08.interpretiveCaution: This is spiritual liberation imagery, not a promise of freedom from illness or grief.

sohila|sohila04.line09.simpleEn: They discover the enduring Divine, the Lord beyond decay, and the shabad describes their spiritual honour through creation.
sohila|sohila04.line09.simplePa: ਉਹ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਪਛਾਣਦੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਆਤਮਕ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨੂੰ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਫੈਲਿਆ ਦਿਖਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila04.line09.interpretiveCaution: Cosmic honour is devotional expression, not a claim of measurable personal fame.

sohila|sohila04.line10.simpleEn: We are humble and small before You, O great Lord; please keep us in Your protection.
sohila|sohila04.line10.simplePa: ਹੇ ਵੱਡੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਅਸੀਂ ਗਰੀਬ ਤੇ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਹਾਂ; ਸਾਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੱਖੋ।
sohila|sohila04.line10.interpretiveCaution: Humility in prayer need not mean surrendering personal dignity or asking for protection instead of practical safety.

sohila|sohila04.line11.simpleEn: Nanak says Naam is the servant’s support and foundation; peace is found in that remembrance.
sohila|sohila04.line11.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ ਕਿ ਨਾਮ ਹੀ ਸੇਵਕ ਦਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਤੇ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ; ਉਸ ਨਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੁਖ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila04.line11.interpretiveCaution: Naam as support is the concluding spiritual theme, not a substitute for ordinary help or care.

sohila|sohila05.line01.simpleEn: Source heading: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Mahala 5, attributed to Guru Arjan Sahib.
sohila|sohila05.line01.simplePa: ਇਹ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਰਾਗ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਅਤੇ ਮਹਲਾ ਪੰਜਵਾਂ — ਗੁਰੂ ਅਰਜਨ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ — ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila05.line01.interpretiveCaution: This identifies the source raag and Guru; a reading translation should not recast it as a devotional sentence.

sohila|sohila05.line03.simpleEn: Earn the true spiritual profit of remembering Hari in this life, so that your onward dwelling may be peaceful.
sohila|sohila05.line03.simplePa: ਇਸ ਜੀਵਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਦਾ ਸੱਚਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਖੱਟੋ, ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਅੱਗੇ ਦਾ ਸਫ਼ਰ ਸੁਖ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੋਵੇ।
sohila|sohila05.line03.interpretiveCaution: The trade/profit metaphor relates to spiritual purpose, not a promise about literal financial return.

sohila|sohila05.line04.simpleEn: Our allotted span of life grows shorter as day and night pass.
sohila|sohila05.line04.simplePa: ਦਿਨ ਅਤੇ ਰਾਤ ਦੇ ਲੰਘਣ ਨਾਲ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੀ ਅਉਧ ਘਟਦੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila05.line04.interpretiveCaution: This is an invitation to awareness of impermanence, not a clinical life-expectancy estimate.

sohila|sohila05.line05.simpleEn: O mind, meet the Guru and bring the purpose of your life into order. This is the refrain.
sohila|sohila05.line05.simplePa: ਹੇ ਮਨ, ਗੁਰੂ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲ ਕੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਜੀਵਨ ਦਾ ਅਸਲ ਕੰਮ ਸੰਵਾਰ; ਇਹ ਰਹਾਉ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila05.line05.interpretiveCaution: The imperative concerns the spiritual purpose of life, not a demand to be constantly productive.

sohila|sohila05.line06.simpleEn: This world is full of entanglement, harmful impulses and doubt; spiritual wisdom helps one cross through.
sohila|sohila05.line06.simplePa: ਇਸ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਸੇ ਹਨ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ-ਗਿਆਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਪਾਰ ਹੋਣ ਦੀ ਸੇਧ ਪਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila05.line06.interpretiveCaution: Crossing an ocean/world is metaphorical; do not teach this as immunity from mental-health difficulty.

sohila|sohila05.line07.simpleEn: The one awakened and given the sweetness of Divine awareness comes to know the otherwise indescribable teaching.
sohila|sohila05.line07.simplePa: ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪ ਜਗਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ-ਰਸ ਦਾ ਸੁਆਦ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਅਕਥ ਅਨੁਭਵ ਦੀ ਸਮਝ ਪਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila05.line07.interpretiveCaution: The “taste” and ineffable story are spiritual images, not literal intoxicants or a sensory test.

sohila|sohila05.line08.simpleEn: Acquire the purpose for which you came into life: let Hari dwell within the mind through the Guru.
sohila|sohila05.line08.simplePa: ਜਿਸ ਅਸਲ ਕੰਮ ਲਈ ਆਏ ਹੋ, ਉਸ ਦਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਲਵੋ; ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਹਰਿ ਨੂੰ ਮਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਸਾਓ।
sohila|sohila05.line08.interpretiveCaution: “Trade” and “purchase” continue the shabad’s ethical/spiritual profit metaphor.

sohila|sohila05.line09.simpleEn: Rest in your own true inner home and receive peace in natural poise; the verse speaks of freedom from the cycle of return.
sohila|sohila05.line09.simplePa: ਆਪਣੇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਹਜ ਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਓ; ਬਾਣੀ ਮੁੜ-ਮੁੜ ਆਉਣ ਦੇ ਚੱਕਰ ਤੋਂ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਦੀ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਦਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ।
sohila|sohila05.line09.interpretiveCaution: The inner home and no-return are theological images; they are not literal travel directions or a scientific claim.

sohila|sohila05.line10.simpleEn: O Knower of hearts, the Creator, please receive and fulfil the sincere longing within my mind.
sohila|sohila05.line10.simplePa: ਹੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਕਰਤਾਰ, ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਦੀ ਸੱਚੀ ਸ਼ਰਧਾ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਂਘ ਨੂੰ ਕਬੂਲ ਕਰੋ।
sohila|sohila05.line10.interpretiveCaution: A prayer to the all-knowing Divine does not imply every worldly desire will be fulfilled on demand.

sohila|sohila05.line11.simpleEn: Nanak asks for this joy alone: make me as humble as the dust beneath the feet of the saintly.
sohila|sohila05.line11.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਹਨ ਕਿ ਮੈਂ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਧੂੜ ਵਰਗਾ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਬਣਾਂ।
sohila|sohila05.line11.interpretiveCaution: Dust-of-feet is an image of profound humility, not an instruction for humiliating a person.

savaiye|savaiye01.line01.simpleEn: The speaker has explored communities of shravaks, siddhs, yogis and practitioners of restraint, considering many ways of spiritual discipline.
savaiye|savaiye01.line01.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਨੇ ਸ਼੍ਰਾਵਕਾਂ, ਸਿੱਧਾਂ, ਜੋਗੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਜਤੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਰਾਹ ਤੇ ਡੇਰੇ ਵੇਖੇ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye01.line01.interpretiveCaution: Sravag, siddh and jati are historical religious terms requiring qualified Braj-language review. This is not a verdict on today’s communities.

savaiye|savaiye01.line02.simpleEn: Valiant figures and assemblies of saints from many ways of thought also enter this wide survey.
savaiye|savaiye01.line02.simplePa: ਵੱਡੇ ਸੂਰਮਿਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਮੱਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਸੰਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਮੂਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਵੀ ਵਿਸ਼ਾਲ ਜ਼ਿਕਰ ਹੈ।
savaiye|savaiye01.line02.interpretiveCaution: The Sanskritic figures are poetic and traditional; avoid treating the passage as a verified travelogue.

savaiye|savaiye01.line03.simpleEn: Having looked across many lands and opinions, the poet questions whether outward paths alone disclose the Lord of life.
savaiye|savaiye01.line03.simplePa: ਅਨੇਕ ਦੇਸਾਂ ਤੇ ਮੱਤਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਵੇਖ ਕੇ ਕਵੀ ਪੁੱਛਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਹਰਲੇ ਰਾਹ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਣਾਂ ਦੇ ਮਾਲਕ ਦੀ ਸੱਚੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ?
savaiye|savaiye01.line03.interpretiveCaution: The critique concerns inward realization, not human dignity or the worth of followers of other religions.

savaiye|savaiye01.line04.simpleEn: Without even a tiny measure of loving Divine grace, impressive outward practices carry little spiritual weight in this comparison.
savaiye|savaiye01.line04.simplePa: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ-ਭਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀ ਰਤਾ ਭਰ ਸਾਂਝ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਵੱਡੇ ਕਰਮ ਵੀ ਅਸਲ ਆਤਮਕ ਮੋਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾਂਦੇ।
savaiye|savaiye01.line04.interpretiveCaution: The repeated rati is a poetic measure; it is not a numerical method of spiritual evaluation.

savaiye|savaiye02.line01.simpleEn: Magnificent, towering elephants are imagined dressed in gold and fine colours to display royal splendour.
savaiye|savaiye02.line01.simplePa: ਸੋਨੇ ਅਤੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਰੰਗਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਸਜੇ ਵੱਡੇ ਮਸਤ ਹਾਥੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਰਾਜਸੀ ਸ਼ਾਨ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਗਈ ਹੈ।
savaiye|savaiye02.line01.interpretiveCaution: Courtly imagery illustrates worldly wealth, not a recommendation to possess or exploit animals.

savaiye|savaiye02.line02.simpleEn: Countless powerful horses leap like deer and seem fast enough to challenge the wind.
savaiye|savaiye02.line02.simplePa: ਅਣਗਿਣਤ ਤਾਕਤਵਰ ਘੋੜੇ ਹਿਰਨਾਂ ਵਾਂਗ ਕੁੱਦਦੇ ਤੇ ਪਵਣ ਜਿਹੀ ਰਫ਼ਤਾਰ ਵਾਲੇ ਦੱਸੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye02.line02.interpretiveCaution: Wind and deer are poetic comparisons, not measured animal speeds.

savaiye|savaiye02.line03.simpleEn: Even strong-armed rulers bow their heads in respect before such a mighty sovereign.
savaiye|savaiye02.line03.simplePa: ਬਲਵਾਨ ਰਾਜੇ ਵੀ ਉਸ ਤਾਕਤਵਰ ਬਾਦਸ਼ਾਹ ਅੱਗੇ ਆਦਰ ਨਾਲ ਸਿਰ ਝੁਕਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye02.line03.interpretiveCaution: Specific courtly forms and grammar are provisional pending qualified Dasam/Braj review.

savaiye|savaiye02.line04.simpleEn: Yet at the end of life, even the greatest king leaves barefoot and empty-handed. What did all that status achieve?
savaiye|savaiye02.line04.simplePa: ਪਰ ਅੰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਵੀ ਨੰਗੇ ਪੈਰ ਅਤੇ ਖਾਲੀ ਹੱਥ ਚਲਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਫਿਰ ਇੰਨੀ ਸ਼ਾਨ ਦਾ ਕੀ ਲਾਭ?
savaiye|savaiye02.line04.interpretiveCaution: This is an image of mortality, not a claim that possessions or responsible leadership have no legitimate purpose.

savaiye|savaiye03.line01.simpleEn: Victorious rulers travel across the lands while great drums and kettledrums announce their triumphs.
savaiye|savaiye03.line01.simplePa: ਜਿੱਤਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਰਾਜੇ ਦੇਸਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਢੋਲ, ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਤੇ ਨਗਾਰੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਜਿੱਤ ਗੂੰਜਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye03.line01.interpretiveCaution: The imagery portrays conquest; it does not instruct or endorse present-day aggression.

savaiye|savaiye03.line02.simpleEn: Great elephants resound, and thousands of noble horses neigh amid the spectacle of military strength.
savaiye|savaiye03.line02.simplePa: ਵੱਡੇ ਹਾਥੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਗੂੰਜ ਅਤੇ ਹਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਘੋੜਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਹਿਣਹਿਣਾਹਟ ਫੌਜੀ ਸ਼ਾਨ ਦਾ ਸ਼ੋਰ ਬਣਦੀ ਹੈ।
savaiye|savaiye03.line02.interpretiveCaution: The animals and their sounds are heightened imagery, not a literal recorded event.

savaiye|savaiye03.line03.simpleEn: Who can count the many sovereigns who ruled in the past or will be rulers in the future?
savaiye|savaiye03.line03.simplePa: ਭੂਤਕਾਲ ਅਤੇ ਭਵਿੱਖ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਰਾਜਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਕੌਣ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ?
savaiye|savaiye03.line03.interpretiveCaution: A rhetorical question about human rank and passing time, not a historically complete count.

savaiye|savaiye03.line04.simpleEn: Without devoted remembrance of the Divine, even renowned rulers eventually reach the end of mortal life.
savaiye|savaiye03.line04.simplePa: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਤੇ ਯਾਦ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਉਹ ਨਾਮੀ ਰਾਜੇ ਵੀ ਆਖ਼ਰ ਮੌਤ ਦੇ ਘਰ ਪਹੁੰਚਦੇ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye03.line04.interpretiveCaution: The poem’s concern is mortality and devotion, not a medical forecast or literal geography of death.

savaiye|savaiye04.line02.simpleEn: Vedas, Puranas, Katebs and Quran, and the teachings of distant lands and ages, are all mentioned.
savaiye|savaiye04.line02.simplePa: ਵੇਦ, ਪੁਰਾਣ, ਕਤੇਬ ਅਤੇ ਕੁਰਾਨ ਸਮੇਤ ਕਈ ਦੇਸਾਂ ਤੇ ਸਮਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਧਾਰਮਿਕ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਦਾ ਜ਼ਿਕਰ ਹੈ।
savaiye|savaiye04.line02.interpretiveCaution: Naming other sacred texts is a poetic survey, not permission to mock the people who read them.

savaiye|savaiye04.line03.simpleEn: Extreme austerity, restricted food, strict restraint and innumerable other disciplines are placed in the same comparison.
savaiye|savaiye04.line03.simplePa: ਹਵਾ-ਆਹਾਰ ਵਰਗੀਆਂ ਕਠਨ ਤਪੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ, ਜਤ ਅਤੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੰਜਮ ਵੀ ਇਸ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye04.line03.interpretiveCaution: This lists ascetic practices; it is not advice to starve, hold breath, hyperventilate or risk health.

savaiye|savaiye04.line04.simpleEn: Without sincere remembrance of the Divine, the poet says that even a vast list of practices loses spiritual significance.
savaiye|savaiye04.line04.simplePa: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਭਜਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਇਹ ਸਾਰੀ ਵੱਡੀ ਰਸਮਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਤਪੱਸਿਆਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਵੀ ਆਤਮਕ ਮੋਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣਾਉਂਦੀ।
savaiye|savaiye04.line04.interpretiveCaution: Charity, sincere spiritual practice and ethical discipline are not themselves being declared worthless.

savaiye|savaiye05.line01.simpleEn: Formidable soldiers wearing armour and fine equipment are pictured as able to defeat hostile armies.
savaiye|savaiye05.line01.simplePa: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਾਜ਼-ਸਨਾਹ ਪਹਿਨੇ ਬਲਵਾਨ ਸਿਪਾਹੀ ਵੈਰੀ ਫੌਜਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਜਿੱਤਦੇ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਗਏ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye05.line01.interpretiveCaution: Martial praise is contextual imagery; it is not a call to harm anyone.

savaiye|savaiye05.line02.simpleEn: Filled with pride, these mighty figures think nothing could move them, as though they were mountains.
savaiye|savaiye05.line02.simplePa: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਹੁਤ ਗੁਮਾਨ ਹੈ; ਉਹ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਨੂੰ ਪਹਾੜ ਵਾਂਗ ਅਡੋਲ ਮੰਨਦੇ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye05.line02.interpretiveCaution: The winged mountain image is rhetorical; uncommon Braj expressions still need comparison.

savaiye|savaiye05.line03.simpleEn: They break resistance, overcome difficult strongholds, and bring the pride of mighty elephants low.
savaiye|savaiye05.line03.simplePa: ਉਹ ਵੈਰੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਜ਼ੋਰ ਤੋੜਦੇ, ਔਖੇ ਥਾਂ ਜਿੱਤਦੇ ਤੇ ਮਸਤ ਹਾਥੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਮਾਣ ਘਟਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye05.line03.interpretiveCaution: The martial language is descriptive, not operational guidance or an invitation to cruelty.

savaiye|savaiye05.line04.simpleEn: But even the proudest and strongest warriors will leave the world; they cannot stand apart from Divine grace.
savaiye|savaiye05.line04.simplePa: ਪਰ ਇੰਨੇ ਬਲਵਾਨ ਤੇ ਗੁਮਾਨੀ ਸੂਰਮੇ ਵੀ ਆਖ਼ਰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਛੱਡ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ; ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਤਾਕਤ ਅਧੂਰੀ ਹੈ।
savaiye|savaiye05.line04.interpretiveCaution: The closing line contrasts temporary strength with humility, not ordinary duties to protect others.

savaiye|savaiye06.line01.simpleEn: The verse speaks of extraordinary warriors who meet even the sharp edge of battle without hesitation.
savaiye|savaiye06.line01.simplePa: ਇਹ ਤੁਕ ਅਜੇਹੇ ਵੱਡੇ ਬਹਾਦਰ ਸੂਰਮਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਕਰਦੀ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਤਿੱਖੀ ਲੜਾਈ ਦਾ ਵੀ ਸਾਹਮਣਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye06.line01.interpretiveCaution: The unusual “saar ki dhaar bhachhayya” needs specialist Braj interpretation; it must not be read as literal steel consumption.

savaiye|savaiye06.line02.simpleEn: Such figures conquer lands, overcome difficult opponents and humble powerful war elephants.
savaiye|savaiye06.line02.simplePa: ਉਹ ਦੇਸ ਜਿੱਤਦੇ, ਔਖੇ ਵਿਰੋਧੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਹਰਾਉਂਦੇ ਤੇ ਬਲਵਾਨ ਹਾਥੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਮਾਣ ਤੋੜਦੇ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye06.line02.interpretiveCaution: Names for opponents or fortified places remain lexically uncertain; this is descriptive poetry, not violent instruction.

savaiye|savaiye06.line03.simpleEn: They break strong fortresses and speak as though they could set the four quarters of the world stirring.
savaiye|savaiye06.line03.simplePa: ਉਹ ਪੱਕੇ ਕਿਲ੍ਹੇ ਤੋੜਦੇ ਅਤੇ ਬੋਲਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਚਾਰਾਂ ਦਿਸ਼ਾਵਾਂ ਹਿਲਾਉਣ ਵਰਗੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕਰਦੇ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye06.line03.interpretiveCaution: The “four quarters” signals breadth and boastful acclaim, not a literal geophysical event.

savaiye|savaiye06.line04.simpleEn: Above every mighty human leader is the One Lord, the true Giver, while countless beings come as petitioners.
savaiye|savaiye06.line04.simplePa: ਸਭ ਦਾ ਅਸਲ ਮਾਲਕ ਇੱਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ-ਦਾਤਾਰ ਹੈ; ਮੰਗਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਹਨ ਪਰ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਉਹ ਇੱਕ ਹੈ।
savaiye|savaiye06.line04.interpretiveCaution: The ending turns from the grandeur of warriors to the single source of gifts and spiritual support.

savaiye|savaiye07.line01.simpleEn: Demons, gods, serpent-lords and other beings of traditional stories appear in the vast picture of remembrance across time.
savaiye|savaiye07.line01.simplePa: ਦਾਨਵ, ਦੇਵ, ਫਣੀੰਦਰ ਅਤੇ ਨਿਸਾਚਰ ਵਰਗੇ ਪੁਰਾਣਕ ਪਾਤਰ ਵੀ ਸਮੇਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਸ਼ਾਲ ਜਾਪ ਵਾਲੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye07.line01.interpretiveCaution: These are mythic/traditional figures, not a claim that such beings have been observed scientifically.

savaiye|savaiye07.line02.simpleEn: All beings in water and upon land are described as established through the Divine order, moment by moment.
savaiye|savaiye07.line02.simplePa: ਪਾਣੀ ਅਤੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਦੇ ਜੀਵ ਪਲ-ਪਲ ਰੱਬੀ ਹੁਕਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਥਾਪਿਤ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਗਏ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye07.line02.interpretiveCaution: Poetic creation language does not specify a measurable biological process or literal timeline.

savaiye|savaiye07.line03.simpleEn: Merit and honour are pictured as increasing while vast accumulations of wrongdoing wear away.
savaiye|savaiye07.line03.simplePa: ਪੁੰਨ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਵਧਣ ਅਤੇ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਦੇ ਵੱਡੇ ਢੇਰ ਮੁਕਣ ਦੀ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਹੈ।
savaiye|savaiye07.line03.interpretiveCaution: The grammar of the Braj verbal forms needs human review. Do not turn spiritual merit into an app score.

savaiye|savaiye07.line04.simpleEn: Groups of sincere seekers are depicted as rejoicing while hostile powers lose their force before them.
savaiye|savaiye07.line04.simplePa: ਸਾਧ-ਸੰਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਗਈ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਵੈਰੀ ਤਾਕਤਾਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਅੱਗੇ ਕਮਜ਼ੋਰ ਪੈਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye07.line04.interpretiveCaution: The verb ending “avalok chapenge” has not been philologically adjudicated; this is provisional context, not a literal certified translation.

savaiye|savaiye08.line01.simpleEn: The image expands even to mighty kings, Indra-like rulers and elephant-lords reigning over three worlds.
savaiye|savaiye08.line01.simplePa: ਵੱਡੇ ਰਾਜਿਆਂ, ਇੰਦਰ ਵਰਗੇ ਸ਼ਾਸਕਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਗਜੇਂਦਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤਿੰਨ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦੇ ਰਾਜ ਵਾਲੀ ਸ਼ਾਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।
savaiye|savaiye08.line01.interpretiveCaution: Traditional “three worlds” imagery is theological poetry, not a claim about a modern astronomical map.

savaiye|savaiye08.line02.simpleEn: They may perform innumerable ritual baths, donate great elephants and arrange splendid ceremonies.
savaiye|savaiye08.line02.simplePa: ਉਹ ਕ੍ਰੋੜਾਂ ਇਸ਼ਨਾਨ, ਹਾਥੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਵੱਡੇ ਦਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ਾਨਦਾਰ ਰਸਮਾਂ ਕਰਦੇ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਗਏ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye08.line02.interpretiveCaution: This addresses outward ritual prestige, not a condemnation of hygiene, service or genuine generosity.

savaiye|savaiye08.line03.simpleEn: Even the traditional figures Brahma, Mahesh, Vishnu and Indra are depicted as subject to time and death.
savaiye|savaiye08.line03.simplePa: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ, ਮਹੇਸ਼, ਵਿਸ਼ਨੂ ਅਤੇ ਇੰਦਰ ਵਰਗੇ ਪੁਰਾਣਕ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਵੀ ਕਾਲ ਦੇ ਫੰਧੇ ਹੇਠ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye08.line03.interpretiveCaution: The Sikh theological contrast must not be turned into contempt for believers in other traditions.

savaiye|savaiye08.line04.simpleEn: Those who find refuge at the Divine feet through grace are portrayed as freed from the cycle of taking birth again.
savaiye|savaiye08.line04.simplePa: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਲ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਮੁੜ ਜਨਮ ਦੇ ਚੱਕਰ ਤੋਂ ਮੁਕਤ ਦੱਸੇ ਗਏ ਹਨ।
savaiye|savaiye08.line04.interpretiveCaution: “No further body” is a spiritual assertion inside the devotional poem, not a clinically testable promise.

savaiye|savaiye09.line01.simpleEn: What is gained merely by closing the eyes and sitting in an impressive crane-like pose of meditation?
savaiye|savaiye09.line01.simplePa: ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਅੱਖਾਂ ਮੀਟ ਕੇ ਬਗਲੇ ਵਾਂਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਦੇ ਦਿਖਾਵੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੈਠਣ ਨਾਲ ਕੀ ਲਾਭ?
savaiye|savaiye09.line01.interpretiveCaution: The crane image critiques hollow performance, not sincere meditation, disability or closing one’s eyes.

savaiye|savaiye09.line02.simpleEn: A person may bathe through the seven seas yet lose the deeper purpose of this life and the life beyond.
savaiye|savaiye09.line02.simplePa: ਕੋਈ ਸੱਤ ਸਮੁੰਦਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਸ਼ਨਾਨ ਕਰ ਆਵੇ ਪਰ ਇਸ ਲੋਕ ਅਤੇ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਦਾ ਅਸਲ ਮਕਸਦ ਗਵਾ ਬੈਠੇ।
savaiye|savaiye09.line02.interpretiveCaution: The seven seas are poetic exaggeration, not travel documentation or a necessary pilgrimage.

savaiye|savaiye09.line03.simpleEn: Someone may spend an entire lifetime caught up in external attractions or formal practice without transforming the heart.
savaiye|savaiye09.line03.simplePa: ਮਨੁੱਖ ਪੂਰੀ ਉਮਰ ਬਾਹਰਲੇ ਮੋਹ ਜਾਂ ਰਸਮਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਿਤਾ ਦੇਵੇ ਪਰ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰੋਂ ਨਾ ਬਦਲੇ।
savaiye|savaiye09.line03.interpretiveCaution: The “bikhiaan” construction needs Braj-language review. This is a contextual draft, not a literal grammatical ruling.

savaiye|savaiye10.line01.simpleEn: One person places a stone object for worship while another wears a sacred emblem around the neck.
savaiye|savaiye10.line01.simplePa: ਕੋਈ ਪੱਥਰ ਦੀ ਮੂਰਤ ਰੱਖ ਕੇ ਪੂਜਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਕੋਈ ਗਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਧਾਰਮਿਕ ਚਿੰਨ੍ਹ ਪਹਿਨਦਾ ਹੈ।
savaiye|savaiye10.line01.interpretiveCaution: The image names outward practices in a critique; do not ridicule people who follow another faith.

savaiye|savaiye10.line02.simpleEn: Some direct their worship toward one region, while others turn west and bow their heads.
savaiye|savaiye10.line02.simplePa: ਕੋਈ ਇੱਕ ਦਿਸ਼ਾ ਵੱਲ ਰੱਬ ਨੂੰ ਲੱਭਦਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਕੋਈ ਪੱਛਮ ਵੱਲ ਮੂੰਹ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਸੀਸ ਨਿਵਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
savaiye|savaiye10.line02.interpretiveCaution: Ritual directions here are examples of outward practice. Represent other communities respectfully and accurately.

savaiye|savaiye10.line03.simpleEn: Some bow before idols; others hurry to worship images or memorials associated with the dead.
savaiye|savaiye10.line03.simplePa: ਕੋਈ ਬੁੱਤਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪੂਜਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਕੋਈ ਮ੍ਰਿਤਕਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੇ ਚਿੰਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਪੂਜਾ ਵੱਲ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
savaiye|savaiye10.line03.interpretiveCaution: The historical terms “butan” and “mritan” require qualified review; no modern community should be caricatured.

savaiye|savaiye10.line04.simpleEn: The poet’s conclusion is that entanglement in empty religious display can leave people without true recognition of the Divine.
savaiye|savaiye10.line04.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਦਾ ਨਿਸਕਰਸ਼ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਖੋਖਲੇ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਫਸ ਕੇ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਸੱਚੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਤੋਂ ਵਾਂਝਾ ਰਹਿ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।
savaiye|savaiye10.line04.interpretiveCaution: This is a spiritual critique of hollow ritual, not a denial of the dignity of other believers.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras02.line01.simpleEn: The speaker asks the Divine to defeat or remove those who threaten and harm.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras02.line01.simplePa: ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਾਨੂੰ ਨੁਕਸਾਨ ਪਹੁੰਚਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਵੈਰੀ ਤਾਕਤਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਹਰਾ ਦੇਹੋ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras02.line01.interpretiveCaution: The prayer uses forceful historic enemy-language. Keep its poetic martial context; do not label current people enemies or use prayer as authorization to injure them.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras02.line02.simpleEn: With Your own protecting hand, rescue me and keep me safe.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras02.line02.simplePa: ਆਪਣੇ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਵਾਲੇ ਹੱਥ ਨਾਲ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਬਚਾ ਲਵੋ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras02.line02.interpretiveCaution: The prayer uses forceful historic enemy-language. Keep its poetic martial context; do not label current people enemies or use prayer as authorization to injure them.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras02.line03.simpleEn: May my family dwell in peace and safety.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras02.line03.simplePa: ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਸੁਖ-ਸ਼ਾਂਤੀ ਨਾਲ ਵਸਦਾ ਰਹੇ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras02.line03.interpretiveCaution: The prayer uses forceful historic enemy-language. Keep its poetic martial context; do not label current people enemies or use prayer as authorization to injure them.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras02.line04.simpleEn: O Creator, extend this care to the servants and Sikhs as well.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras02.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਕਰਤਾਰ, ਆਪਣੇ ਸੇਵਕਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸਿੱਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਵੀ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਕਰ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras02.line04.interpretiveCaution: The prayer uses forceful historic enemy-language. Keep its poetic martial context; do not label current people enemies or use prayer as authorization to injure them.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras03.line01.simpleEn: Protect me through Your own hand and power, the speaker pleads.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras03.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਆਪਣੇ ਹੀ ਹੱਥ ਨਾਲ ਮੇਰੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਕਰ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras03.line01.interpretiveCaution: Opponents in this historical martial vocabulary cannot be assigned to a modern community without context. The closing thirst for bhajan frames the prayer spiritually.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras03.line02.simpleEn: May hostile and harmful opposition be brought to an end, the prayer continues.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras03.line02.simplePa: ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਲ ਵੈਰ ਤੇ ਨੁਕਸਾਨ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਤਾਕਤਾਂ ਦਾ ਅੰਤ ਹੋਵੇ—ਇਹ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras03.line02.interpretiveCaution: Opponents in this historical martial vocabulary cannot be assigned to a modern community without context. The closing thirst for bhajan frames the prayer spiritually.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras03.line03.simpleEn: May my hopes and sincere longings find completion.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras03.line03.simplePa: ਮੇਰੀਆਂ ਆਸਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਮਨ ਦੀ ਸੱਚੀ ਚਾਹ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਵੇ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras03.line03.interpretiveCaution: Opponents in this historical martial vocabulary cannot be assigned to a modern community without context. The closing thirst for bhajan frames the prayer spiritually.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras03.line04.simpleEn: Above all, may the thirst to remember and praise You remain within me.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras03.line04.simplePa: ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਜਨ ਦੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਮੇਰੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਸਦਾ ਬਣੀ ਰਹੇ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras03.line04.interpretiveCaution: Opponents in this historical martial vocabulary cannot be assigned to a modern community without context. The closing thirst for bhajan frames the prayer spiritually.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras04.line01.simpleEn: Apart from You, I do not turn my deepest contemplation toward another refuge.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras04.line01.simplePa: ਤੇਰੇ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਮੈਂ ਹੋਰ ਕਿਸੇ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣਾ ਅੰਤਿਮ ਆਸਰਾ ਮੰਨ ਕੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਧਿਆਉਂਦਾ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras04.line01.interpretiveCaution: The stanza combines personal devotion, requested gifts and conflict. The expression about foes is devotional verse, never a directive to attack actual people.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras04.line02.simpleEn: Whatever blessing I ask for, I seek it from You.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras04.line02.simplePa: ਜੋ ਵੀ ਵਰ ਮੰਗਦਾ ਹਾਂ, ਉਹ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੋਲੋਂ ਹੀ ਮੰਗਦਾ ਹਾਂ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras04.line02.interpretiveCaution: The stanza combines personal devotion, requested gifts and conflict. The expression about foes is devotional verse, never a directive to attack actual people.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras04.line03.simpleEn: Carry through danger the servants and Sikhs who rely upon You.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras04.line03.simplePa: ਸਾਡੇ ਸੇਵਕਾਂ ਤੇ ਸਿੱਖਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸੰਕਟਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਪਾਰ ਲੰਘਾ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras04.line03.interpretiveCaution: The stanza combines personal devotion, requested gifts and conflict. The expression about foes is devotional verse, never a directive to attack actual people.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras04.line04.simpleEn: The poet petitions for the defeat of every hostile force threatening his people.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras04.line04.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਆਪਣੇ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਨੁਕਸਾਨ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਵੈਰੀ ਤਾਕਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਸ ਦੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras04.line04.interpretiveCaution: The stanza combines personal devotion, requested gifts and conflict. The expression about foes is devotional verse, never a directive to attack actual people.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras05.line01.simpleEn: With Your own hand, lift me up and rescue me.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras05.line01.simplePa: ਆਪਣੇ ਹੱਥ ਨਾਲ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਉਬਾਰ ਕੇ ਬਚਾ ਲਵੋ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras05.line01.interpretiveCaution: “Asidhuj” is a traditional divine epithet here, not a self-issued human license to wield weapons; prayer about death never proves invulnerability.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras05.line02.simpleEn: May my fear at the time of death be taken away.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras05.line02.simplePa: ਮੌਤ ਦੀ ਘੜੀ ਆਉਣ ਵੇਲੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਡਰ ਦੂਰ ਹੋਵੇ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras05.line02.interpretiveCaution: “Asidhuj” is a traditional divine epithet here, not a self-issued human license to wield weapons; prayer about death never proves invulnerability.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras05.line03.simpleEn: Always remain on my side as my support.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras05.line03.simplePa: ਤੂੰ ਸਦਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਬਣ ਕੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੱਖ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹਿ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras05.line03.interpretiveCaution: “Asidhuj” is a traditional divine epithet here, not a self-issued human license to wield weapons; prayer about death never proves invulnerability.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras05.line04.simpleEn: O revered Asidhuj, grant Your protection.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras05.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਸਿਧੁਜ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਮੇਰੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਕਰ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras05.line04.interpretiveCaution: “Asidhuj” is a traditional divine epithet here, not a self-issued human license to wield weapons; prayer about death never proves invulnerability.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras06.line01.simpleEn: O Protector, please save and shelter me.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras06.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਰੱਖਣਹਾਰੇ, ਮੈਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਵਿੱਚ ਲੈ ਲਵੋ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras06.line01.interpretiveCaution: Fourteen worlds is a traditional cosmological image, not an astronomical measurement. Invoking a protector does not negate ordinary medical or physical safety precautions.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras06.line02.simpleEn: You are the dear Lord and helper of the saintly.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras06.line02.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ, ਤੂੰ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੈਂ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras06.line02.interpretiveCaution: Fourteen worlds is a traditional cosmological image, not an astronomical measurement. Invoking a protector does not negate ordinary medical or physical safety precautions.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras06.line03.simpleEn: You are friend of the humble and the one who overcomes harmful wickedness.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras06.line03.simplePa: ਤੂੰ ਦੀਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਸਾਥੀ ਤੇ ਦੁਰਜਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਨੁਕਸਾਨ ਨੂੰ ਰੋਕਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras06.line03.interpretiveCaution: Fourteen worlds is a traditional cosmological image, not an astronomical measurement. Invoking a protector does not negate ordinary medical or physical safety precautions.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras06.line04.simpleEn: You are sovereign throughout all the fourteen realms of traditional imagination.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras06.line04.simplePa: ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਧਾਰਮਿਕ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਦੇ ਚੌਦਾਂ ਭਵਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਵੀ ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਮਾਲਕ ਹੈਂ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras06.line04.interpretiveCaution: Fourteen worlds is a traditional cosmological image, not an astronomical measurement. Invoking a protector does not negate ordinary medical or physical safety precautions.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras07.line01.simpleEn: When the appointed time came, Brahma took a form, the verse says.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras07.line01.simplePa: ਕਾਲ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਆਉਣ ਉੱਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਨੇ ਰੂਪ ਧਾਰਿਆ—ਤੁਕ ਇਉਂ ਦੱਸਦੀ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras07.line01.interpretiveCaution: Named traditional divine figures are part of a theological contrast; the poem must not be used to demean people of other faiths or converted into a historical chronology.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras07.line02.simpleEn: At another appointed time, Shiva also appeared.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras07.line02.simplePa: ਕਾਲ ਦੇ ਅਧੀਨ ਸ਼ਿਵ ਜੀ ਦਾ ਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਾ ਹੋਇਆ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras07.line02.interpretiveCaution: Named traditional divine figures are part of a theological contrast; the poem must not be used to demean people of other faiths or converted into a historical chronology.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras07.line03.simpleEn: Vishnu too is portrayed as manifested within the reach of time.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras07.line03.simplePa: ਵਿਸ਼ਨੂ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ ਵੀ ਕਾਲ ਦੇ ਅਧੀਨ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras07.line03.interpretiveCaution: Named traditional divine figures are part of a theological contrast; the poem must not be used to demean people of other faiths or converted into a historical chronology.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras07.line04.simpleEn: All these manifestations are pictured as part of the vast play of time.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras07.line04.simplePa: ਇਹ ਸਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵੇ ਕਾਲ ਦੇ ਵਿਸ਼ਾਲ ਖੇਲ ਵਾਂਗ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਗਏ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras07.line04.interpretiveCaution: Named traditional divine figures are part of a theological contrast; the poem must not be used to demean people of other faiths or converted into a historical chronology.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras08.line01.simpleEn: The Divine power within time is described as making Shiva a yogi.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras08.line01.simplePa: ਕਾਲ ਦੇ ਮਾਲਕ ਨੇ ਸ਼ਿਵ ਨੂੰ ਜੋਗੀ ਬਣਾਇਆ—ਇਹ ਕਵੀ ਦੀ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras08.line01.interpretiveCaution: “Kaal” carries layered meanings: time, death and the Timeless in this poetic context. An unqualified dictionary substitution may reverse the theology.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras08.line02.simpleEn: Through that same creative power, Brahma became the knower or ruler of the Vedas.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras08.line02.simplePa: ਉਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵ ਹੇਠ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਵੇਦਾਂ ਦੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜਿਆ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras08.line02.interpretiveCaution: “Kaal” carries layered meanings: time, death and the Timeless in this poetic context. An unqualified dictionary substitution may reverse the theology.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras08.line03.simpleEn: That power is credited with arranging and sustaining all the worlds.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras08.line03.simplePa: ਉਸੇ ਨੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਦੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਕੀਤੀ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras08.line03.interpretiveCaution: “Kaal” carries layered meanings: time, death and the Timeless in this poetic context. An unqualified dictionary substitution may reverse the theology.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras08.line04.simpleEn: To that One, beyond the limited figures, I offer salutations.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras08.line04.simplePa: ਉਸ ਇੱਕੋ ਅਕਾਲ ਸਰੋਤ ਅੱਗੇ ਮੈਂ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras08.line04.interpretiveCaution: “Kaal” carries layered meanings: time, death and the Timeless in this poetic context. An unqualified dictionary substitution may reverse the theology.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras09.line01.simpleEn: That One created the whole world and its many forms.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras09.line01.simplePa: ਉਸ ਇੱਕ ਨੇ ਇਹ ਸਾਰਾ ਜਗਤ ਰਚਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras09.line01.interpretiveCaution: The mythic categories in the second line are source-poetic, not laboratory classes. The choice of the Guru is theological devotion, not a claim against others’ dignity.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras09.line02.simpleEn: Divine beings, adversarial beings and yakshas are also named among creation.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras09.line02.simplePa: ਦੇਵ, ਦੈਤ ਅਤੇ ਜੱਖ ਵਰਗੇ ਪੁਰਾਣਕ ਪਾਤਰ ਵੀ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਗਿਣੇ ਗਏ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras09.line02.interpretiveCaution: The mythic categories in the second line are source-poetic, not laboratory classes. The choice of the Guru is theological devotion, not a claim against others’ dignity.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras09.line03.simpleEn: The One alone is spoken of as present at the beginning and at the end.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras09.line03.simplePa: ਆਦਿ ਤੋਂ ਅੰਤ ਤਕ ਉਹ ਇੱਕੋ ਆਸਰਾ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras09.line03.interpretiveCaution: The mythic categories in the second line are source-poetic, not laboratory classes. The choice of the Guru is theological devotion, not a claim against others’ dignity.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras09.line04.simpleEn: Know that same One as my Guru, the speaker declares.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras09.line04.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਆਖਦਾ ਹੈ: ਉਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਨੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਮਝੋ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras09.line04.interpretiveCaution: The mythic categories in the second line are source-poetic, not laboratory classes. The choice of the Guru is theological devotion, not a claim against others’ dignity.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras10.line01.simpleEn: I offer my respectful salutation only to that One.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras10.line01.simplePa: ਮੈਂ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਹੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹਾਂ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras10.line01.interpretiveCaution: The martial expression about enemies is in a petition of praise; do not use it as a threat or assertion that all hardship vanishes for a devout reader.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras10.line02.simpleEn: That One has shaped and ordered all living beings.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras10.line02.simplePa: ਉਸੇ ਨੇ ਸਾਰੀ ਪਰਜਾ ਨੂੰ ਰਚ ਕੇ ਸੰਭਾਲਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras10.line02.interpretiveCaution: The martial expression about enemies is in a petition of praise; do not use it as a threat or assertion that all hardship vanishes for a devout reader.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras10.line03.simpleEn: To the devotees the One is praised as bringing peace and good qualities.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras10.line03.simplePa: ਆਪਣੇ ਸੇਵਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉਹ ਸੁੱਖ ਅਤੇ ਚੰਗੇ ਗੁਣ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਦਾ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras10.line03.interpretiveCaution: The martial expression about enemies is in a petition of praise; do not use it as a threat or assertion that all hardship vanishes for a devout reader.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras10.line04.simpleEn: Hostile forces are described as overcome in an instant by that power.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras10.line04.simplePa: ਵੈਰੀ ਤਾਕਤਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉਹ ਪਲ ਭਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਰਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ—ਇਉਂ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras10.line04.interpretiveCaution: The martial expression about enemies is in a petition of praise; do not use it as a threat or assertion that all hardship vanishes for a devout reader.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras11.line01.simpleEn: The One knows what lies within every heart, in every being.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras11.line01.simplePa: ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰ ਜੀਵ ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras11.line01.interpretiveCaution: Intimate knowledge of the heart is devotional language, not a warrant for us to judge another person’s unseen thoughts. The ant-to-elephant comparison includes all beings.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras11.line02.simpleEn: The joys and pains of people, good and bad, are known to that One.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras11.line02.simplePa: ਭਲੇ ਤੇ ਬੁਰੇ ਸਭ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਪੀੜ ਤੇ ਹਾਲ ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਲੁਕੇ ਨਹੀਂ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras11.line02.interpretiveCaution: Intimate knowledge of the heart is devotional language, not a warrant for us to judge another person’s unseen thoughts. The ant-to-elephant comparison includes all beings.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras11.line03.simpleEn: From a tiny ant to a huge elephant, all creatures are included.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras11.line03.simplePa: ਨਿੱਕੀ ਚੀਟੀ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੇ ਹਾਥੀ ਤਕ ਸਭ ਜੀਵ ਇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਆ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras11.line03.interpretiveCaution: Intimate knowledge of the heart is devotional language, not a warrant for us to judge another person’s unseen thoughts. The ant-to-elephant comparison includes all beings.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras11.line04.simpleEn: The Divine looks on everyone with a gaze of compassionate grace.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras11.line04.simplePa: ਉਹ ਸਭ ਉੱਤੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀ ਨਿਗਾਹ ਰੱਖਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras11.line04.interpretiveCaution: Intimate knowledge of the heart is devotional language, not a warrant for us to judge another person’s unseen thoughts. The ant-to-elephant comparison includes all beings.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line01.simpleEn: The suffering of saintly people is felt with concern by the Compassionate One.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line01.simplePa: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਨਾਲ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line01.interpretiveCaution: Poetry speaks of divine compassion through human terms for suffering and happiness; do not conclude that all forms of suffering are divinely approved or clinically avoidable.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line02.simpleEn: Their happiness and peace are likewise honoured with joy.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line02.simplePa: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਸੁੱਖ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line02.interpretiveCaution: Poetry speaks of divine compassion through human terms for suffering and happiness; do not conclude that all forms of suffering are divinely approved or clinically avoidable.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line03.simpleEn: The One recognizes each individual’s particular pain.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line03.simplePa: ਹਰੇਕ ਜੀਵ ਦੀ ਆਪਣੀ ਪੀੜ ਉਹ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line03.interpretiveCaution: Poetry speaks of divine compassion through human terms for suffering and happiness; do not conclude that all forms of suffering are divinely approved or clinically avoidable.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line04.simpleEn: Every inner covering and secret of each heart is known to the Divine.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line04.simplePa: ਹਰ ਘਟ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰਲਾ ਪਰਦਾ ਅਤੇ ਭੇਦ ਵੀ ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਓਹਲੇ ਨਹੀਂ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line04.interpretiveCaution: Poetry speaks of divine compassion through human terms for suffering and happiness; do not conclude that all forms of suffering are divinely approved or clinically avoidable.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line01.simpleEn: When the Creator brings forth or expands creation, the poetic scene opens outward.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line01.simplePa: ਜਦੋਂ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਦਾ ਵਿਸਤਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ ਫੈਲਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line01.interpretiveCaution: “Udarkh/akarkh” are old literary formulations of expansion and withdrawal, NOT modern cosmological equations. Their precise Braj morphology needs specialist review.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line02.simpleEn: Countless beings then come into embodied existence.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line02.simplePa: ਤਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੀਵ ਦੇਹਾਂ ਧਾਰ ਕੇ ਜਨਮ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line02.interpretiveCaution: “Udarkh/akarkh” are old literary formulations of expansion and withdrawal, NOT modern cosmological equations. Their precise Braj morphology needs specialist review.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line03.simpleEn: When the Creator draws that expansive creation inward again, its forms withdraw.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line03.simplePa: ਜਦੋਂ ਉਹ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਨੂੰ ਮੁੜ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਮੇਟਦਾ ਹੈ, ਰੂਪ ਸਿਮਟ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line03.interpretiveCaution: “Udarkh/akarkh” are old literary formulations of expansion and withdrawal, NOT modern cosmological equations. Their precise Braj morphology needs specialist review.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line04.simpleEn: All embodied beings are portrayed as returning into that One.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line04.simplePa: ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇਹਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਜੀਵ ਉਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਵਿੱਚ ਲੀਨ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਦੱਸੇ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line04.interpretiveCaution: “Udarkh/akarkh” are old literary formulations of expansion and withdrawal, NOT modern cosmological equations. Their precise Braj morphology needs specialist review.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line01.simpleEn: The whole creation has many voices, mouths and forms of expression.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line01.simplePa: ਸਾਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੂੰਹ ਅਤੇ ਬੋਲਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਜੀਵ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line01.interpretiveCaution: Human descriptions are necessarily partial; references to the Vedas or the world must not be treated as proof that each speaker’s separate theology is identical.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line02.simpleEn: Each describes the Divine according to their own understanding.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line02.simplePa: ਹਰੇਕ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਮਝ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਬਾਰੇ ਬੋਲਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line02.interpretiveCaution: Human descriptions are necessarily partial; references to the Vedas or the world must not be treated as proof that each speaker’s separate theology is identical.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line03.simpleEn: Yet You remain distinct from, and beyond, every one of those descriptions.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line03.simplePa: ਪਰ ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਹੱਦਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line03.interpretiveCaution: Human descriptions are necessarily partial; references to the Vedas or the world must not be treated as proof that each speaker’s separate theology is identical.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line04.simpleEn: The Vedas and the learned world try to understand this profound mystery.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line04.simplePa: ਵੇਦਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਜਗਤ ਦੇ ਗਿਆਨੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਇਸ ਗੂੜ੍ਹੇ ਭੇਦ ਦੀ ਭਾਲ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line04.interpretiveCaution: Human descriptions are necessarily partial; references to the Vedas or the world must not be treated as proof that each speaker’s separate theology is identical.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line01.simpleEn: The One is without confining form, corruption or dependence on another support.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line01.simplePa: ਉਹ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ, ਵਿਕਾਰ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ ਤੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਆਸਰੇ ਦਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜ ਨਹੀਂ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line01.interpretiveCaution: Several Sanskritic/Braj adjectives are densely packed; these are broad working senses only. “Beyond distinctions” should not be used to erase human moral accountability.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line02.simpleEn: Beyond ordinary beginnings, colour or birth, the One is self-existent.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line02.simplePa: ਉਹ ਆਦਿ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ, ਰੰਗ ਅਤੇ ਜਨਮ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚਾ ਤੇ ਆਪ ਹੋਂਦ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line02.interpretiveCaution: Several Sanskritic/Braj adjectives are densely packed; these are broad working senses only. “Beyond distinctions” should not be used to erase human moral accountability.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line03.simpleEn: A person without understanding tries to divide this limitless One into narrow categories.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line03.simplePa: ਅਣਜਾਣ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਉਸ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਹਸਤੀ ਦੇ ਸੀਮਤ ਭੇਦ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line03.interpretiveCaution: Several Sanskritic/Braj adjectives are densely packed; these are broad working senses only. “Beyond distinctions” should not be used to erase human moral accountability.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line04.simpleEn: Even sacred texts cannot completely grasp the One’s deepest mystery.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line04.simplePa: ਵੇਦਾਂ ਵਰਗੇ ਧਰਮ-ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਵੀ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਸਾਰਾ ਭੇਦ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾ ਸਕਦੇ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line04.interpretiveCaution: Several Sanskritic/Braj adjectives are densely packed; these are broad working senses only. “Beyond distinctions” should not be used to erase human moral accountability.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line01.simpleEn: Some imagine the limitless Divine to be fully represented by a stone form.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line01.simplePa: ਕੋਈ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਪੱਥਰ ਦੇ ਰੂਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਮਝ ਬੈਠਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line01.interpretiveCaution: The original uses sharp polemical words about treating the formless One as an object or a named deity. Explain the Sikh theological distinction without mocking people or sacred objects of other traditions.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line02.simpleEn: The poet sharply calls that a misunderstanding of the deeper reality.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line02.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਡੂੰਘੀ ਸੱਚਾਈ ਦਾ ਭੇਦ ਨਾ ਜਾਣਣਾ ਆਖਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line02.interpretiveCaution: The original uses sharp polemical words about treating the formless One as an object or a named deity. Explain the Sikh theological distinction without mocking people or sacred objects of other traditions.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line03.simpleEn: Some address Mahadev as though that name alone exhausted the Eternal Divine.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line03.simplePa: ਕੋਈ ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਦੇ ਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਹੀ ਸਦਾ-ਸ਼ਿਵ ਦੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੱਦ ਮੰਨ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line03.interpretiveCaution: The original uses sharp polemical words about treating the formless One as an object or a named deity. Explain the Sikh theological distinction without mocking people or sacred objects of other traditions.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line04.simpleEn: Such outward naming, the poet argues, can miss the formless mystery.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line04.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਇਹ ਨਾਂ ਫੜਨ ਨਾਲ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਦਾ ਅਸਲ ਭੇਦ ਅਣਪਛਾਤਾ ਰਹਿ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line04.interpretiveCaution: The original uses sharp polemical words about treating the formless One as an object or a named deity. Explain the Sikh theological distinction without mocking people or sacred objects of other traditions.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line01.simpleEn: Each person has only as much understanding as their own mind can hold.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line01.simplePa: ਹਰ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਦੀ ਬੁੱਧੀ ਦੀ ਆਪਣੀ ਇੱਕ ਹੱਦ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line01.interpretiveCaution: The first two lines acknowledge diverse human understandings; the final questions express wonder, not a literal refusal of all inquiry or scientific cosmology.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line02.simpleEn: So people describe You in differing ways according to that understanding.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line02.simplePa: ਇਸ ਲਈ ਲੋਕ ਆਪਣੀ-ਆਪਣੀ ਸਮਝ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਢੰਗ ਨਾਲ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line02.interpretiveCaution: The first two lines acknowledge diverse human understandings; the final questions express wonder, not a literal refusal of all inquiry or scientific cosmology.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line03.simpleEn: Your vast creation cannot be fully measured or comprehended.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line03.simplePa: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਾਰਾ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਕਿਸੇ ਦੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਉਂਦਾ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line03.interpretiveCaution: The first two lines acknowledge diverse human understandings; the final questions express wonder, not a literal refusal of all inquiry or scientific cosmology.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line04.simpleEn: How, indeed, did this world first come into being? The poet wonders.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line04.simplePa: ਇਹ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਰਚਿਆ ਗਿਆ—ਕਵੀ ਅਚਰਜ ਨਾਲ ਪੁੱਛਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line04.interpretiveCaution: The first two lines acknowledge diverse human understandings; the final questions express wonder, not a literal refusal of all inquiry or scientific cosmology.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line01.simpleEn: The One appears as a single, incomparable Divine reality amid countless forms.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line01.simplePa: ਅਨੇਕ ਰੂਪਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਉਹ ਇੱਕੋ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line01.interpretiveCaution: Four “khanis” are a traditional way of classifying forms of birth: egg, womb, moisture and vegetation; they are not four exhaustive modern biological categories.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line02.simpleEn: At one place a poor person appears, at another a ruler or king.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line02.simplePa: ਕਿਤੇ ਰੰਕ ਤੇ ਕਿਤੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਜਾਂ ਭੂਪ ਦਿੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line02.interpretiveCaution: Four “khanis” are a traditional way of classifying forms of birth: egg, womb, moisture and vegetation; they are not four exhaustive modern biological categories.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line03.simpleEn: The poem names beings born from eggs, wombs and moisture.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line03.simplePa: ਅੰਡਿਆਂ, ਗਰਭਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਨਮੀ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੇ ਰਵਾਇਤੀ ਜਨਮ-ਭੇਦ ਗਿਣੇ ਗਏ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line03.interpretiveCaution: Four “khanis” are a traditional way of classifying forms of birth: egg, womb, moisture and vegetation; they are not four exhaustive modern biological categories.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line04.simpleEn: It adds plants or sprouting life as another form of the One’s creation.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line04.simplePa: ਉੱਗਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਬਨਸਪਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ਦੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਦਾ ਰੂਪ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line04.interpretiveCaution: Four “khanis” are a traditional way of classifying forms of birth: egg, womb, moisture and vegetation; they are not four exhaustive modern biological categories.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line01.simpleEn: In one place the One’s power is pictured as the splendour of a king.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line01.simplePa: ਕਿਤੇ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਖੇਲ ਰਾਜੇ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਾਨ ਵਾਂਗ ਦਿੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line01.interpretiveCaution: These are poetic ways to point beyond fixed worldly form and status. “Sankar” has contextual lexical ambiguity and needs Dasam/Braj collation.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line02.simpleEn: In another, a contracted or ascetic form appears in the poem’s imagery.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line02.simplePa: ਕਿਤੇ ਉਸੇ ਖੇਲ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਟਿਆ ਜਾਂ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਵਰਗਾ ਰੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line02.interpretiveCaution: These are poetic ways to point beyond fixed worldly form and status. “Sankar” has contextual lexical ambiguity and needs Dasam/Braj collation.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line03.simpleEn: The whole creation displays an astonishing variety of forms.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line03.simplePa: ਸਾਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਅਚਰਜ-ਭਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਰੂਪ ਵਿਖਾਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line03.interpretiveCaution: These are poetic ways to point beyond fixed worldly form and status. “Sankar” has contextual lexical ambiguity and needs Dasam/Braj collation.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line04.simpleEn: Yet its Source is described as self-existent from the beginning of ages.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line04.simplePa: ਪਰ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਮੂਲ ਆਦਿ-ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਤੋਂ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਂਦ ਵਾਲਾ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line04.interpretiveCaution: These are poetic ways to point beyond fixed worldly form and status. “Sankar” has contextual lexical ambiguity and needs Dasam/Braj collation.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line01.simpleEn: Now, O Divine Protector, please shelter me from the dangers before me.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਹੁਣ ਮੇਰੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਕਰ ਅਤੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਸੰਕਟ ਤੋਂ ਬਚਾ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line01.interpretiveCaution: The original includes severe martial words “asikhya”, “dusht” and “malechh”. These are historically charged and can demean religious communities if misapplied. Do not equate contemporary non-Sikhs with enemies, endorse group violence or promise violent divine punishment. Human reviewer REQUIRED.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line02.simpleEn: Protect Sikh followers and overcome those portrayed as resisting or harming them.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line02.simplePa: ਸਿੱਖ ਸੇਵਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਬਚਾ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਨੁਕਸਾਨ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਨੂੰ ਰੋਕ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line02.interpretiveCaution: The original includes severe martial words “asikhya”, “dusht” and “malechh”. These are historically charged and can demean religious communities if misapplied. Do not equate contemporary non-Sikhs with enemies, endorse group violence or promise violent divine punishment. Human reviewer REQUIRED.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line03.simpleEn: The poem describes malicious forces that raise conflict and disturbance.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line03.simplePa: ਦੁਸ਼ਟ ਤਾਕਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਉਪਦ੍ਰਵ ਅਤੇ ਫਸਾਦ ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line03.interpretiveCaution: The original includes severe martial words “asikhya”, “dusht” and “malechh”. These are historically charged and can demean religious communities if misapplied. Do not equate contemporary non-Sikhs with enemies, endorse group violence or promise violent divine punishment. Human reviewer REQUIRED.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line04.simpleEn: Using severe historical battle-language, the poet petitions for the defeat of hostile forces.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line04.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਇਤਿਹਾਸਕ ਜੰਗੀ ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਨਾਲ ਵੈਰੀ ਤਾਕਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਹਾਰਨ ਦੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line04.interpretiveCaution: The original includes severe martial words “asikhya”, “dusht” and “malechh”. These are historically charged and can demean religious communities if misapplied. Do not equate contemporary non-Sikhs with enemies, endorse group violence or promise violent divine punishment. Human reviewer REQUIRED.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line01.simpleEn: Those who seek refuge in You, O Asidhuj, place themselves under Your protection.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਅਸਿਧੁਜ, ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਆਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line01.interpretiveCaution: “Asidhuj” is a Divine name in this composition. Conflict imagery does not turn other humans into legitimate targets; refuge is the central request.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line02.simpleEn: The poem pictures their hostile persecutors as defeated and distressed.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line02.simplePa: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਤਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਵੈਰੀ ਤਾਕਤਾਂ ਦੁਖੀ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਹਾਰਦੀਆਂ ਦਿਖਾਈਆਂ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line02.interpretiveCaution: “Asidhuj” is a Divine name in this composition. Conflict imagery does not turn other humans into legitimate targets; refuge is the central request.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line03.simpleEn: People who bow at Your feet in humble dependence turn toward You.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line03.simplePa: ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨਿਮਰਤਾ ਨਾਲ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਿਰ ਨਿਵਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line03.interpretiveCaution: “Asidhuj” is a Divine name in this composition. Conflict imagery does not turn other humans into legitimate targets; refuge is the central request.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line04.simpleEn: From their troubles and dangers, You are asked to deliver them.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line04.simplePa: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਭ ਸੰਕਟ ਤੂੰ ਦੂਰ ਕਰ—ਇਹ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line04.interpretiveCaution: “Asidhuj” is a Divine name in this composition. Conflict imagery does not turn other humans into legitimate targets; refuge is the central request.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line01.simpleEn: Whoever remembers the One even once in the difficulties of this age turns toward Divine refuge.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line01.simplePa: ਜੋ ਇਸ ਕਲਿਯੁਗ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕ ਵਾਰ ਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਯਾਦ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਵੱਲ ਮੁੜਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line01.interpretiveCaution: Claims that death or harm cannot approach a devotee are devotional expressions of spiritual protection; they must not be interpreted as clinical immortality, neglect of danger or a replacement for emergency care.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line02.simpleEn: The poet portrays the power of death as unable to draw near that devotee.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line02.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਦੀ ਭਗਤੀ-ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਾਲ ਦੀ ਤਾਕਤ ਉਸ ਭਗਤ ਦੇ ਨੇੜੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਉਂਦੀ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line02.interpretiveCaution: Claims that death or harm cannot approach a devotee are devotional expressions of spiritual protection; they must not be interpreted as clinical immortality, neglect of danger or a replacement for emergency care.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line03.simpleEn: That protection is praised as available through all times.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line03.simplePa: ਉਸ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਨੂੰ ਹਰ ਵੇਲੇ ਦਾ ਸਹਾਰਾ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line03.interpretiveCaution: Claims that death or harm cannot approach a devotee are devotional expressions of spiritual protection; they must not be interpreted as clinical immortality, neglect of danger or a replacement for emergency care.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line04.simpleEn: Hostility and harmful misfortune are envisioned as passing away at once.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line04.simplePa: ਵੈਰ ਅਤੇ ਬਿਪਤਾ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਹਟਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਗਏ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line04.interpretiveCaution: Claims that death or harm cannot approach a devotee are devotional expressions of spiritual protection; they must not be interpreted as clinical immortality, neglect of danger or a replacement for emergency care.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras23.line01.simpleEn: The person who receives Your compassionate gaze is remembered in prayer.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras23.line01.simplePa: ਜਿਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀ ਨਿਗਾਹ ਪੈਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਦੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਇੱਥੇ ਯਾਦ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ।
